before: Runtime baseline: 2 positive controls pass and malformed-size test fails. Both parser wrappers accept all five authored pasp payload lengths (0,4,7,9,12 bytes), treating failed field reads as absence or ignoring trailing data.
change: Require exactly the two u32 spacing fields (8 payload bytes) for a present pasp. Propagate field read errors rather than converting them into absence. Existing zero-spacing fallback and absent-box behavior stay intact.
after: 51 distinct checks pass in 8 integration targets. Dedicated positive controls cover exact normalized 2:1 aspect, square absence and existing zero fallback, random packet reads, analytic YUV16, native software RGB, exact clocks, 24 seeks, rewind and EOF. Related MP4 parsing, rotation/aspect, sample-description changes, video reconfiguration, edit/refusal and timing regressions pass. Locked offline no-default-features core build check passes.
fixtures: 12 byte-identical regenerated files: eight own 3-frame VP9 movies, three analytic YUV16 oracles and manifest; offline tests use saved assets without generator, FFmpeg or network.
scope: One malformed fixed-size aspect-box parsing problem; size variants and positive controls do not add IDs. Refusal qualification, not a new visual renderer or aspect-ratio rendering claim.
limitations: Existing zero-spacing fallback policy is retained, not requalified as normative support.
No new visual/UI behavior or performance improvement is claimed.
No project-wide green or physical GPU parity claim; historical unrelated baseline failures remain separate.
